verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows a Marketing API and in-app reports that list which recipients clicked links. It never documents an API endpoint for reading a specific contact's history of sends, opens and clicks. Transactional webhooks that push open/click events and UI-level click reports are adjacent features, not a per-contact engagement-history read API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact
